name: Milo Darnell
source_profile:
Milo Darnell (LN) — Wagonmaster and Independent Freight Proprietor

Milo is an experienced wagonmaster who operates a small freight business transporting lumber, provisions, and manufactured goods between Thornhollow and the settlements along the Great Eastway. His family has worked the woodland roads for generations, and he possesses an intimate knowledge of the routes, crossings, and isolated waystations upon which the region's commerce depends.

A cautious and dependable businessman, Milo has prospered by maintaining reliable service to merchants whose shipments are too small or irregular to attract the attention of larger transportation concerns. His customers include independent mill owners, Briarhearth farmers, and smaller timber merchants.

The expansion of Eastway Overland & Express has placed his business under growing pressure. The company's extensive resources, preferred commercial contracts, and efforts to secure exclusive access to certain roads threaten the independence of smaller wagoners. Milo regards Dawson Tull with particular suspicion, believing the company's right-of-way negotiations are intended to establish effective monopolies over the most profitable routes.

Milo maintains a longstanding commercial relationship with Tilda Morrow and has occasionally transported goods for the Briarhearth Freeholds. He generally supports the marquessa's efforts to improve the forest roads, but fears that the resulting infrastructure will ultimately serve only those businesses wealthy enough to control it.
